newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Unggul to acquire Salim Oleochemicals.
newsitem.headline: Unggul to acquire Salim Oleochemicals.

text.p: Indonesian chemical firm PT Unggul Indah Corporation said on Tuesday it planned to acquire a 100-percent stake in Singapore-based Salim Oleochemicals Pte Ltd for $20 million.
Unggul said in a statement the firm planned to seek approval for the plan at a shareholders meeting on June 25.
Salim Oleochemicals (SOC) is a producer and distributor of various chemicals products, the statement said.
It did not give further details.
Both SOC and Unggul Indah are members of the Salim Group conglomerate.
Unggul, a manufacturer of alkylbenzene, a raw material for detergents, posted a net profit of 41.27 billion rupiah in 1996 against 32.76 billion rupiah in 1995.
